name: Hooklistener Free Webhook Debugger
free_limit: Free hosted plan: 1 debug endpoint, 50 stored requests per endpoint, 1 day of request history, 1 seat, and MCP access; $0 per month.
watch_out: Free stores at most 50 webhook requests for 1 day, not 50 new requests per month. Official billing docs say new requests return HTTP 403 when storage is full until old requests expire or are deleted; do not rely on this plan for guaranteed production delivery. Paid plans offer larger quotas, history and production features. Anonymous endpoints are session-scoped; sign up for persistent endpoints. Free-plan commercial/production rights are not expressly guaranteed.
